description: Link — faithful Electron + Capacitor port of KDE Connect's protocol

scripts.build:android: cd desktop && npx vite build --base=./ && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('../mobile/www', {recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('../mobile/www',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist/renderer', '../mobile/www', {recursive:true})" && cd ../mobile && npm run build:android
